name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: A busy quarter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I only have a few days left to hit my end of quarter goal, Peter.
#
Peter,
A lot has happened in the first three months of the year. Throughout it all, **I’ve continued my fight on behalf of working families, our communities, and our planet.**
I championed the policies that President Biden spoke about in his State of the Union address like cutting the cost of prescription drugs, lowering the cost of childcare for middle class families, enforcing antitrust laws so corporate monopolies aren’t taking advantage of the people, and making the wealthiest pay their fair share of taxes.
That’s why I also called on President Biden to take a series of critical executive actions and use his power to accomplish our shared goals. We must deliver important wins for working families by canceling student debt, securing paid sick leave and vacation for millions of workers, investing in clean energy, clean air, and clean water, and so much more.
[In order to keep our fight as strong as ever, my team tells me we need to hit a $35,000 end-of-quarter goal by 11:59 p.m. on March 31. Can you chip in $3 or anything at all to help fuel my fight for the rest of this critical election year, Peter?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11470?refcode=em20220328-1140&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=1140%2E420207%2E5PI6G6)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11470?refcode=em20220328-1140&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1140%2E420207%2E5PI6G6)**
And those were just some of the highlights.
I continue my advocacy for Medicare for All and every policy that expands health care coverage and cuts costs for working families. I also led letters to government agencies urging them to protect Medicare from private profiteers.
I introduced the Climate Resilience Workforce Act to invest in a skilled workforce capable of responding to and preparing for the destructive impacts of climate change. We enacted a law I co-led called the Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act — to empower sexual assault survivors to choose how they want to seek justice for abusive treatment, and allow them to have their day in court.
I’ve led the charge to cut wasteful military spending that only benefits private defense contractors, and I’ve advocated for an end to private immigrant detention centers. Protecting voting rights and our democracy remains front and center in my fight.
**Peter, our fight for bold, progressive change is critical.** We face lobbying from the largest corporations in America and an extreme GOP willing to stop us no matter what. That’s why I rely on grassroots support, and why I need you to chip in right now.
[Can you chip in $3 today to help us hit our crucial end-of-quarter goal? Together, we can enact progressive change, fight for our planet, and cut costs for working people.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11470?refcode=em20220328-1140&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1140%2E420207%2E5PI6G6)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11470?refcode=em20220328-1140&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1140%2E420207%2E5PI6G6)**
In solidarity,
Pramila

| Dear Friends,

After the weekend's sunshine and a taste of Utah's spring weather, **I am thrilled to start another week on the campaign!** With the end of March close on our heels, **our momentum is stronger than ever—and we couldn't have done it without you. **

My team and I had the opportunity to attend **five county conventions** on Saturday, **traveling close to 200 miles over 15 hours across Northern Utah. **

**To all delegates who attended their county convention this weekend, thank you!** Your choice to support our caucus convention system is **critical to strengthening civic engagement in our state.** The delegate-candidate conversations made possible by our system are **essential for representation.** These conventions **make me a better candidate** and you a better voter.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Over the weekend, **we asked you to show up to support our signature goal,** and you did not disappoint.

**Just this weekend, our volunteers collected more than 2,000 signatures!**

Our amazing volunteers, dedicated signature team, and supporters like you are the **core of this campaign.** Your efforts make it possible to reach voters in **every corner of the state.** Our momentum is strong, but **the Utah Office of Elections' deadline for submitting signatures is only TWO WEEKS AWAY! **

The Biden administration’s humiliating retreat from Afghanistan was an unmitigated disaster that continues to have tragic consequences on the world st | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e72b4949591d/re-thank-you-15333104?e=d32193ab14)

An Urgent Message From Keith Swank
---
---
| |
---
|
# Do you actually believe Biden and Pelosi when they say we’re on the right track and doing well?

If anyone actually believes that, then I’ve got some oceanfront property in Arizona to sell em’ too.

The rising cost of gas, energy, and inflation is killing our country and our economy.

_We’ve allowed career politicians and special interests to badly bungle our economic and national security and we’re reaping the deadly consequences.

The Biden administration’s humiliating retreat from Afghanistan was an unmitigated disaster that continues to have tragic consequences on the world stage; likely costing hundreds of thousands, if not millions of lives in the long run._

**_It’s not far-fetched to say this election could decide the fate of our nation—and the world._**

You can help me stop this destruction by helping me defeat an entrenched puppet of Nancy Pelosi and crush our time sensitive end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.

**_[There’s only FOUR DAYS left to meet a very important goal of raising another $10,500 just before the end of the quarter. Help us win by chipping in and donating $25, $50, $100, or even just $10 today!](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=959355b323&e=d32193ab14)_**

**As a U.S. Army Airborne Infantry Soldier and Police Officer I learned that you can’t defeat an organized opposition force without teamwork.** **This is a nation-wide all-hands-on-deck effort to defeat the democrat machine this November. **

I need you in this fight with me. I’m not afraid of my opponent, Pelosi, or their shady special interest groups.

**_I’ve been spit on, kicked, punched, stabbed, shot at, and had to fight for my life just to be here today writing you.

There’s NOTHING that people like Pelosi and her gang could ever say or do to make me back down and compromise your safety or my values._**

_**As a police officer, my mission was to protect the public and keep the streets safe for you and your family. But lots of cops and soldiers can’t count on elected leaders anymore. I’ll be their backup in Congress – and you’ll be mine.**_

_As a cop on the street I could call for backup when I needed help.__ _**_But right now YOU ARE my backup! I'm calling on you today for your help. I need you to help me win this campaign to keep the country safe._**

[**_Please CLICK THIS LINK _**](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=dffdcec620&e=d32193ab14 "Anedot Donate Link")**_[to donate so we can win this fight](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=2fea994f21&e=d32193ab14)_**[** _!_**](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=9bbf169da4&e=d32193ab14)

With your contribution today, I can meet my fundraising goals and fight back to stop this insanity!

This year we have a historic opportunity to flip the 10th Congressional District seat.

My opponent, democrat Marilyn Strickland will have lots of dirty special interest money from D.C. — because sadly, she’s another democrat puppet of the Pelosi/Biden agenda.

I’m not just fighting my democrat opponent, I’m fighting Pelosi and a legion of shady left wing campaign groups; and they’re fighting tooth and nail to stop conservatives like me from winning this election.

**[It’ll take more money for me to stay competitive. I need you to help us compete by chipping in $25, $50, 100 or even just $10 today!](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=66132253e7&e=d32193ab14)**

**_I need your support to stop the crime epidemic, the opioid epidemic, restore our domestic energy production, cut inflation, and secure our border._**

Democrat dark money groups that can’t even pronounce _Puyallup _will run underhanded and misleading attack ads against us. The only way to defeat the lies is to air our own ads and contact voters directly.

We need money to beat Pelosi’s gang so we can take back our nation. We can literally change history with this election and kick Pelosi out of power — blocking her and Biden’s agenda.

**_[I need your backup, please chip in and make a secure online donation today so I can keep fighting!](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=70131a3e58&e=d32193ab14)_**

Pelosi and her gang want to stop us. **_Your support helps us take away Nancy Pelosi's Gavel — and her power to keep hurting our country._**

**_[Donate NOW to back me up and kick Pelosi’s gang out of Congress.](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=8dda79eb6c&e=d32193ab14)_**

**Yours in Freedom,
Keith R. Swank
Keep the Republic Safe | [KeithSwank.com](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=f76f963c91&e=d32193ab14 "http://keithswank.com/index.html")**

**PS: _There’s a big event coming up soon_ that may have to have a limited capacity. If you contribute today I’ll put you first in line to buy tickets for this event. If you donate and join my backup team today you’ll be first to know about this event and on our VIP event invite list. Thank you for everything. [We need more people like you in this fight to save the country. CLICK HERE TO DONATE NOW.](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=39e16d1d4d&e=d32193ab14)**

# **Submit your questions by Wednesday at noon for Friday's GOP debate.**
Dear Friends and Neighbors,

The Northampton County Republican Committee (NCRC) is taking questions from local voters for Friday's congressional debate between Lisa Scheller and me. According to the debate agreement, possible subjects include:
* Crime
* Police
* Religious liberty
* Immigration
* Education
* Transgender issues
* Big tech censorship
* Covid
* Russia/Ukraine
* Energy policy
* China
* Economy
* Inflation
* Taxes
* Debt
* Climate change
* Human life
* Election integrity

In addition, the committee will consider questions about each candidate's leadership style and how we would legislate if elected.

Voters can submit up to three questions by emailing the NCRC at: [ncrcweb@northamptoncountygop.com](mailto:ncrcweb@northamptoncountygop.com?subject=Debate%20Questions&body=Name%3A%0APhone%3A%0AQuestion%20%231%3A%0AQuestion%20%232%3A%0AQuestion%20%233%3A). Or, you can use the NCRC's online submission form [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=4a69d42b84&e=1090c5c412). If you use the form, don't worry if the drop-down menus don't exactly match the subjects listed above. Just choose the category that most closely matches your issue and submit your question.

**Please make sure to submit all questions by noon on Wed., March 30. **

The debate will be held at 7 p.m. on April 1st at Northampton County Community College Alumni Hall. Doors open at 6 p.m. Details are [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=15a335a903&e=1090c5c412).

I've called for this to be the first of several debates leading up the primary. You deserve to hear your candidates publicly discuss the issues affecting voters in PA-7. I hope to see you on Friday.

Meanwhile, to learn more about my plans to KEEP AMERICA FREE please visit [www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=d6a5a31fc7&e=1090c5c412). And, if you would like to donate to my campaign, please click [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=cf64ad09a6&e=1090c5c412). Thank you.

Sincerely,

I’ll be facing Mark Kelly - Chuck Schumer’s right-hand man - [**and I need your support today in order to win this race and help Republicans WIN BACK the Senate majority!**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8bf8bfd0fa0c42c49fa823da5ef7e083&_e=KJkj2TerM6_FKcDDHpV9sgOO47PaqMpi6yynTYCVorFmc676ok0ruRGSQ3UYz8pY56S-vLdZ15PmeQcH5hm4Y6Uq4IhiveqdC-SKLAv6SlT5SfJob6iBjV4zVnMkhMwTVlItqVWbwQFk3Id5LH_AQkjLqvYFlPHd9uoXCj7N7KjEB_-Kyk9E700ue8yCMb_F816axIEzVZ9imPSKYYydO67Vj9RvhCtlPqpIMhhmTAGGWutHMGhntJBz0DSY9mvuwPmUsETlSF4rSSq6jBzK6YnJyEHd5zCqDI7i4AZRIAhNO-5UqxPfW-qh5e809D6KI7QZ5pX6kFbV0oi9aWTrvmkG6P6Wqrp0BBPSlT6L2qbOFMtT1-92o8MD0ehcSPJqTFRq6Yb6h7pNUxS98d4LdIFKyLcFITWjfor6OZMWi9w%3D)

[** ****JOIN MY TEAM ➤ **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8bf8bfd0fa0c42c49fa823da5ef7e083&_e=KJkj2TerM6_FKcDDHpV9sgOO47PaqMpi6yynTYCVorFmc676ok0ruRGSQ3UYz8pY56S-vLdZ15PmeQcH5hm4Y6Uq4IhiveqdC-SKLAv6SlT5SfJob6iBjV4zVnMkhMwTVlItqVWbwQFk3Id5LH_AQkjLqvYFlPHd9uoXCj7N7KjEB_-Kyk9E700ue8yCMb_F3ri5SnOfyLK1D8NsFdVNj2c_r8mwlavTQnwit2TgwKekOkNZ17NlWOuN8vHz64TYoso4MIl-ec5YpSOpxQFLhOexOtzHBd41RE7unRjE13LTOmye9rvycjuMGY70DCxow9qAWn_ihLhDqCD_rXIWsVuP-V9H855i6PFjfrNheIbr2neHq_NainesffueR9BAEgpgYQHW6OQrr1cJSxPRQRP4iBfqc6cKwc0WY-033mQ%3D)
Washington is broken. There are too many politicians who are only worried about making the right decision for THEMSELVES and NOT the American people they promised to protect.

As a former F-16 pilot and retired commanding general of the Arizona National Guard, I know what it takes to lead a team and make split second decisions that is the difference between saving and losing lives.

I’m ready on day one to fight for YOU and for what’s right for this country. That means:
1. Securing our border
2. Standing for life
3. Protecting our First and Second Amendment rights and
4. Walking shoulder to shoulder with law enforcement.

I know the Tar Heel state will have a champion for working people in Cheri.
#

Cory Booker here, reaching out on behalf of my friend and North Carolina’s next Senator Cheri Beasley.
She’s just 3 days away from her biggest FEC deadline yet, and [**a donation of any amount you can spare would go a long way for her campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-mar22?refcode=em220328-2-T1&refcode2=619.357359.Br7zOY&t=1&akid=619%2E357359%2EBr7zOY)**

She’s the kind of candidate who inspires me and gives me hope. Throughout her life, she has fiercely fought for justice and put the best interest of the people first.

My parents were sent to Japanese American internment camps. I’ve faced discrimination myself – as an openly gay Asian American man, many have targeted me because of who I am.

I’ve spent my time in Congress trying to level the playing field for people who have been marginalized, underserved, and discriminated against.

But the Republican Party has fought me at every turn – and 2022 will be no different. My advocacy has made me a top MAGA Republican target, so that’s why I’m reaching out to you.
